references.title: A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas
references.note: Constructs explicit polynomial-size CNF families from expander graphs for which every equivalent DNNF has strongly exponential size; this is the lower-bound half of the decisive H016 refutation.

references.title: Lower Bounds for Polynomial Calculus with Extension Variables over Finite Fields
references.note: Proves finite-field polynomial-calculus lower bounds when each extension variable has bounded dependence on original variables. The theorem attacks but does not literally cover H010's recursively global fan-in-two extensions.

references.title: A Lower Bound for Polynomial Calculus with Extension Rule
references.note: Proves an exponential bit-size lower bound for a strong polynomial-calculus extension system over the rationals. Field and resource measures differ from H010, so the result is a major attack rather than a decisive refutation.

claim_boundary: The references support exact attack steps and boundary audits; they do not certify JANUS novelty or settle unrelated hypotheses.
